_help: Copy this file to config.json (same folder) and change the values. Lines starting with _ are just notes. Use forward slashes / in folder paths, even on Windows.
_watch_folder: Put movie files here (and an optional .srt with the same name). They're moved to Google Drive automatically.
_download_folder: Public-domain films from your wish list are downloaded here first, then uploaded and removed.
_rclone: rclone_path: 'rclone' if it's installed normally, or the full path to rclone.exe. rclone_remote: the name you gave Google Drive in 'rclone config'.
_drive_folder: The Drive folder that holds 'To edit' and 'Ready to post'.
_github: Your GitHub name, the repo name, and a fine-grained token with 'Contents: Read and write' on that repo only.
_timing: How often to look in the folder (seconds), how long a file must stop growing before upload (seconds), how often to read the wish list and to say 'I'm online' (minutes).
_max_download_mb: Skip archive.org files bigger than this (MB).
